newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Peter Lehmann sees strong 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Peter Lehmann sees strong 2nd half.

text.p: Winemaker Peter Lehman Wines (PLW) Ltd said on Friday it expected the strong sales momentum of the first half to continue in the second half despite a very competitive domestic market.

"Whilst it is acknowledged that the domestic market will remain very competitive, PLW is confident that the momentum can be maintained in the second half of the financial year," Peter Lehman Wines said.
Earlier Peter Lehmann reported a 42 percent rise in sales in the six months to December 31 to A$8.98 million and a 71 percent rise in net profit to A$1.04 million.
Export sales grew 52 percent for the half year as more stock became available from the above average 1996 harvest, the winemaker said.
"Further price increases are planned in 1997, but these will be implemented carefully so as not to have a detrimental effect on sales volumes," Peter Lehmann said.
"Current indications are that PLW will continue the momentum in bottled wine sales in both the domestic and export markets," it said.
"Provided there is a satisfactory outcome to the vintage, the directors believe that the second half of the full year will show a good result also."
Peter Lehmann said it did not expect the 1997 harvest to be as high as the above-average 1996 harvest, but grape quality looked good.
Peter Lehmann Wines' shares were unchanged at A$1.25 at 11.00 a.m. (0000 GMT).
